rows.en: (And that's EX-Gear training done for now.)
I was watching you out there.

Yamashiro-sensei!
How did I do?

You're moving quite well.
I'm impressed you haven't forgotten the basics.
Really? Thank you very much.

But don't get complacent.
Danger follows all of you whenever you fly.
Never forget that.

Good answer.
See you. Make sure you get some proper rest.
rows.notes: Answers the player's reply (a shared generic row between c16803 and c16804).

rows.en: (...I'd better stay on my toes.)

(What a tiring week...
What should I do this weekend...?)

\p.
Are you heading home now?
Yes, I don't have anything else to do.

Go straight home, no detours.
And don't laze around this weekend. Study.

Understood, sir!
...So, what are you doing this weekend, Sensei?
rows.notes: Male version: stiff, over-polite 'wakatte orimasu', played as a mock-formal 'Understood, sir!'.

rows.en:
I plan to study at home, so I can teach
all of you even more clearly than I do now.
That's... a lot of work...
It's the job I chose. It's no hardship.
(So cool...)

Well then.
I'll see you again on Monday.
(...When does Sensei ever get any rest?)

Okaaay!
...So, what are you doing this weekend, Sensei?
rows.notes: Female twin of c16810; 'haai' as 'Okaaay' as elsewhere.

rows.en:
(...P.E. wore me out...
A 10 km run? Come on...)
rows.notes: Aligned: taiiku 'P.E.' as in the other campus slices.

rows.en:
\p.
Looks like you got put through the wringer.

Yamashiro-sensei...
That was brutal...

That Gary was extra fired up today.
Don't hold it against him.
Sensei, please rein him in...

It's P.E. Learning your own limits
is important too.
rows.notes: Aligned: taiiku 'P.E.' as in the other campus slices.

rows.en: Anyway, make sure you cool down properly.
(...I'm worried how sore I'll be tomorrow~)

(...Gym class wore me out...
A 10 km run? Come on...)
(...I'm worried how sore I'll be tomorrow...)

(...I've gotta go shopping for dinner~
What should I have?)

Well, if it isn't \p.
What are you doing in a place like this?

Hello, Yamashiro-sensei.
Are you out shopping?
Well, something like that...
What did you buy?
A model aircraft.

Huh~
I didn't know you had a hobby like that.

When I'm putting one of these together,
my mind is at peace...

Well then, see you.
Get home before it gets late.

(I just found out Yamashiro-sensei
has a surprising hobby.)

(...I've gotta go shopping for dinner~
What should I have, I wonder?)

(I just found out Yamashiro-sensei
has a surprising hobby~!)

(Swimming's next.
I've gotta hurry to the pool...)

\p.
Don't run, it's dangerous.
Yamashiro-sensei...
What's with that outfit...?
rows.notes: He is already in a swimsuit (c16846).

rows.en:
Gary is away on a business trip,
so I'm in charge of today's P.E. class.
rows.notes: Aligned: taiiku 'P.E.' as in the other campus slices.

rows.en: ...I see...

(I'd better not ask why he's in
his swimsuit already.)
Well then, I'll go on ahead.

Right.
I won't go easy on you today, so bring it.
(Alrighty, off to swim, swim, swim~)

(Swimming's next.
I've gotta hurry to the pool...)

(I'd better not ask why he's in
his swimsuit already.)
Well then, I'll go on ahead.

(Next class is... Huh...
English, wasn't it...? Uh-oh...)

\p.
Why are you holding your head like that?

Yamashiro-sensei...
I misread the timetable, and my
assignment is at home...

That's what happens when you don't
double-check.
So, which subject?
Um, English... The listening one.

Listening, huh...
Wait here a moment.
That should about do it...

Wh-whoa, you knocked out the assignment
in no time at all...
rows.notes: Yamashiro 'konasu' the assignment in a short time: whether he did it for the player or made a substitute is unclear; 'knocked out' covers both.

rows.en:
I don't do favors like this often.
Come show me the assignment tomorrow.
Without fail.

(Maybe I'd have had it easier
if I'd just stayed forgetful...)

uncertain: c16861: Yamashiro 'konasu' the forgotten listening assignment in moments; unclear whether he did it for the player or produced a substitute; rendered 'knocked out the assignment', which fits either.
c16810: male 'wakatte orimasu' (stiff over-politeness) rendered as a mock-formal 'Understood, sir!'.
